MIDTOWN LOFT & TERRACE
Midtown Loft & Terrace: Manhattan's Premier Event Venue

Midtown Loft & Terrace is your all-in-one venue, offering both a stunning loft and an open-air terrace with a retractable roof at a prime Fifth Avenue location near the Marble Collegiate Church, The Church of the Transfiguration, NoMad, Koreatown, Flatiron, Eataly, Herald Square, Macy's, PATH, and LIRR. It offers magnificent views of the Empire State Building and the NYC skyline.
Whether it is a corporate event, private party, wedding, graduation, prom, or sweet sixteen, Midtown Loft and Terrace's versatile space makes it easy to bring any event to life.

Midtown Terrace: Rooftop Venue near the Empire State Building
Midtown Terrace is a genuinely unique event space, featuring a retractable enclosed rooftop, a modern lobby, and a private elevator that opens onto it.
The upscale interior space features mahogany floors, copper windows, antique light fixtures, and a stunning fireplace, perfect for drinks and conversation.
The landscaped Terrace offers a 360-degree view of the Manhattan skyline, including iconic landmarks like the Empire State Building and Marble Collegiate Church.
With its versatile layout and breathtaking city views, the Midtown Terrace is the perfect venue for cocktail receptions, networking events, intimate celebrations, and year-round event planning.

Midtown Studio NYC: Flexible Meeting and Event Space in Midtown Manhattan
Midtown Studio NYC is a flexible and inviting event space at 267 Fifth Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, just a short walk from the Empire State Building, Herald Square, and the NoMad neighborhood.

The space has a clean, modern feel with a practical layout, LCD screen, lounge seating, a conference table, and games for a flexible private event setup.

FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What does the furniture include?

The included Loft furniture is made of five sets, each with one white leather couch and one glass coffee table. The Alcove furniture includes three white leather couches and one coffee table. The Terrace includes one navy velour sofa, three grey ottomans, a round wooden coffee table, and a mahogany bar.
What standard tables are included?
The venue includes two 6 ft and two 8 ft standard buffet tables in the Loft, and four 6 ft standard buffet tables on the Terrace. All other tables and chairs must be rented.
What are the measurements of the furniture?
The Loft bar base and top are approximately 86 in x 33.5 in x 45.5 in. The Terrace mahogany bar top is about 4 ft 6 in by 2 ft, with a 3 ft 4 in height.
What is the sound system compatibility?
DJs are not allowed to hook into the venue system and must provide their own equipment. The venue provides a wireless microphone for the Loft and a small mixer for basic use.
Is there outside lighting?
Yes, the Terrace includes outside lighting for evening events.
Where is the freight elevator located?
The freight elevator is located on 1/2 East 29th Street between Madison and 5th Avenue, closer to 5th Avenue, at the loading dock between the church and bank on the right hand side of the street.
Can we make an outside bar?
Yes, using the venue's standard buffet tables. Leg extensions would need to be added.
What are the ceiling heights?
The ceiling is 12 ft high and approximately 11 ft high at the beams.
What is the scheduling for rental pick-up and drop-off?
All rentals and deliveries must be dropped off between 9am-12noon and 2pm-5pm, and must be picked up after the event before the contracted breakdown time.
